column1: # 32_12_segger licensed downloads (tab separated). NOT config/pins.tsv: `bootstrap` never fetches these.
# Only `./segger-box install --accept-license` (the user accepts SEGGER's terms) downloads them, by POSTing
# accept_license_agreement=accepted like the download page form. md5 = the value SEGGER publishes in the download
# page metadata (checked 2026-10-25 on https://www.segger.com/downloads/jlink/); SEGGER publishes no sha256, so the
# sha256 is pinned on first download into config/pins.local.tsv (TOFU) and checked on every later install.
